source: Same quantity on both sides (the previous record spelled it NbPicked on the kernel side): the number of entities picked for a 10-unit box under the centre pixel of an 800x600 view, camera at z 50. Bridge: Selector.pick(at:) result .count (Scripts/repro/766-drawing-evidence-fix/swift-side.txt, selector.centre). Kernel: SelectMgr_ViewerSelector NbPicked() after PickPoint, with the bridge's OCCTBRepSelectable and OCCTHeadlessSelector copied into the probe and the camera set as the test sets it (Scripts/repro/766-drawing-evidence-fix/transcript.txt). Zero hits is the shared result on both sides: Selector.pick returns no hit for any scene in SelectorTests (finding in PR #2569), so the tests carry their hit expectations under withKnownIssue.
